hotspots.title: AfD’s surge in German state elections
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) continues to dominate polls in Saxony-Anhalt, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, and other eastern states, with its lead growing despite controversies over extremism and internal conflicts. The party's rise is framed as a threat to democratic norms and stability, with opposition parties struggling to counter its momentum.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high stakes of AfD potentially forming state governments, escalating fears of far-right governance and its implications for Germany’s political landscape.

hotspots.title: Macri-Milei alliance talks in Argentina
hotspots.blurb: Negotiations between former President Mauricio Macri’s PRO party and Javier Milei’s La Libertad Avanza (LLA) have intensified, with high-level meetings aimed at forming a united front for the 2027 elections. The talks are framed as a critical pivot for Milei’s re-election prospects and the future of Argentina’s political right.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high affective investment in Argentina’s political realignment, with Milei’s economic reforms and Macri’s influence seen as pivotal for the country’s future.

hotspots.title: Trump’s secret plane switch amid Iran threat
hotspots.blurb: Reports emerged that President Trump secretly switched planes during a NATO summit in Turkey due to an Iranian assassination threat. The incident is framed as a dramatic security failure, with critics questioning the administration’s handling of the situation and the risks posed to officials left on the decoy plane.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes nature of the threat, the secrecy involved, and the potential implications for U.S. national security and presidential safety protocols.

hotspots.title: Vox’s migration crisis escalation in Ceuta
hotspots.blurb: Vox has intensified its rhetoric over Spain’s migration crisis, particularly in Ceuta, where the party demands immediate action, including deportations and reimbursement from Morocco. The crisis is framed as a national security emergency, with Vox accusing the government of neglect and betrayal.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the moral panic over migration, the polarized contention between Vox and the government, and the high affective investment in border security and national sovereignty.

hotspots.title: Fidesz’s Danube water crisis at Paks
hotspots.blurb: Hungary’s government, led by Péter Magyar, has launched emergency measures to address critically low Danube water levels threatening the Paks nuclear plant. The crisis is framed as a national emergency, with opposition parties accusing the government of mismanagement and excessive spending on solutions.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high stakes of nuclear safety, the polarized contention over government competence, and the moral panic over potential environmental and economic consequences.
